To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the gauge-equivariant Morse homotopy orbits of the real locus of Yang–Mills connections on the double cover of a connected, closed nonorientable surface are all orientable, for any principal U(n) or SU(n) bundle.

the homotopy orbit bundle over the space of gauge-equivalent connections on an SU(2) or U(2)-bundle over a closed, connected, nonorientable, two-dimensional manifold Σ is orientable if and only if Σ does not have a nontrivial orientation double cover, and if and only if the Euler characteristic of Σ is nonzero; the analogous result holds for SU(n) or U(n)-bundles when n = 3.

the normal and associated homotopy bundles to the strata in the Morse stratification of the space of real connections on a principal bundle over a closed, connected surface are orientable for all values of n and all but one of the surfaces.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a topological property of the space of Yang–Mills connections on nonorientable surfaces and its real locus, which we refer to as orientability.
the following question: when is the space of Yang–Mills connections on a principal bundle over a nonorientable surface orientable?
the question of whether or not the Yang–Mills measure on the space of U(n)-connections over a closed surface Σ is a probability measure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
for all n, the space of SU(n)-connections on a principal SU(n)-bundle over any connected, closed, oriented surface is orientable.
the space of connections is orientable when the structure group G is either U(n) or SU(n) and Σ is not the Klein bottle.
the homotopy orbit bundle of the real locus of a space of connections is always orientable when Σ is not the Klein bottle and when n ≤ 3 if Σ is the Klein Bottle.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gauge equivariant cohomology groups H∗(Morse strata, ℝ) are isomorphic to the real cohomology groups of these strata.
the space of connections over any closed nonorientable surface is orientable, and that the normal bundles to its Morse strata are orientable when the structure group has rank less than or equal to 3.
we have shown that the real Morse theory of the Yang–Mills functional on a principal U(1)- or U(n)-bundle, n ≤ 3, over a connected, compact, nonorientable Riemannian 2-manifold is well behaved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the real and complex Yang–Mills moduli spaces are homeomorphic, and that the complex moduli space is orientable for any principal U(n)- or SU(n)-bundle over any connected, closed, orientable surface.
, when n ≥ 3, the real locus of a space of connections on an orientable surface is not homotopy equivalent to the space of connections itself, even though the spaces have the same homotopy type.
the gauge-theoretic constructions on Σ can be understood as a real version of the constructions on its orientable double cover, which is a key ingredient in the construction of the Floer theory on Σ.
